mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing output decline reduces corporate profits and investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without requiring a specific threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 has increased over the past quarter, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a rapidly deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when PAYEMS declines by more than 0.3% and UNRATE rises by more than 0.2% MoM, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), labor market slack suppresses wage growth and consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.
